rationale: The agent file covers every gold theorem. unconditional_allow_thm covers always-permits. unlisted_allowed_thm is the ∉-form equivalent of the pre-dependent vulnerability, and instantiating it with an empty list gives the exploit witness directly. The equivalence theorem appears too, and the correctness theorem is stronger because its precondition is weaker (True). The agent's extra properties are relevant and few, so they don't count as spam.
